digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler adapter family (jira_family shared seam / Jira Data Center backend)
propositions: rebar cannot reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center, which differs from Cloud on REST v2 wiki-markup bodies, PAT bearer auth, and name-based user identity.
DC support should be an explicit shared jira_family sub-seam parameterized by RichTextCodec and UserIdentityModel contracts, not a forked second adapter reaching into jira/ privates.

The local->Jira status and priority maps are already duplicated across three copies and have drifted (only the ACLI copy omits deleted->Done), so they must be single-sourced with deleted->Done adopted as one declared observable change.

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) must not change path or break the dynamic loader; sharing happens via dependency inversion and by editing contents to import from jira_family.
The DC backend must require https for base_url (unless allow_insecure warns), read the PAT only from JIRA_PAT env, and never disable TLS certificate verification.

A machine-checked import contract must keep the boundary enforced so only jira/ and jira_datacenter/ import jira_family/, and installing without the [jira-datacenter] extra pulls in no new dependency.
